hunks.baseline: I knew the formations used at Gates, what to do when a crisis struck, and the weaknesses of various monsters like the back of my hand. My being clueless about legal matters was simply another example of everyone having their own specialty.
hunks.sol: I knew Gate formations, how to respond in a crisis, and the weaknesses of various monsters like the back of my hand. By the same token, I knew next to nothing about legal matters.

hunks.baseline: “Thank you for your hard work.”
hunks.sol: “Thank you for your help.”

hunks.baseline: “You too.”
hunks.sol: “And thank you.”

hunks.baseline: The man in the angular horn-rimmed glasses was the legal scrivener I had hired to handle the real-estate transaction. Across from me, the homeowner and the licensed realtor were exchanging farewells and getting to their feet.
hunks.sol: The man in the angular horn-rimmed glasses was the legal scrivener I had hired to handle the purchase of the house. Across from me, the homeowner and the realtor were exchanging farewells and getting to their feet.

hunks.baseline: “Congratulations on the contract. A young man making it big.”
hunks.sol: “Congratulations on the purchase. You’ve done well for yourself at such a young age.”

hunks.baseline: As I shook hands with the homeowner, I realized something for the first time.
hunks.sol: As I shook hands with the homeowner, something finally sank in.

hunks.baseline: A home we had reclaimed after no less than eleven years.
hunks.sol: A home we had regained after eleven long years.

hunks.baseline: The bed, whose springs had broken long ago. A small wardrobe that could barely hold a few outfits. A desk with its paint peeling off in places. A small TV sitting on top of it.
hunks.sol: The bed whose springs had given out long ago. A small wardrobe that could barely hold a few outfits. A desk with paint peeling off in places, with a small TV sitting on top.

hunks.baseline: After packing up my clothes and assorted belongings, excluding the things I had to leave behind, I filled one cardboard box.
hunks.sol: Once I packed my clothes and assorted belongings, aside from the things I had to leave behind, they filled a single cardboard box.

hunks.baseline: The past seven years were contained inside it. I was staring around the room with a strange tightness in my chest when a voice came from behind me.
hunks.sol: The past seven years were contained inside it. I was staring around the room, my chest strangely tight, when a voice came from behind me.

hunks.baseline: He was someone I couldn’t leave out of my seven years.
hunks.sol: He was someone I couldn’t leave out of those seven years.

hunks.baseline: “I found one, so I’m moving out.”
hunks.sol: “I found one. That’s why I’m moving out.”

hunks.baseline: “No. It’s still a secret. I’m planning to move in first and tell them after my sister finishes her college entrance exam.”
hunks.sol: “No. It’s still a secret. I’m going to live there by myself for now and tell them after my sister finishes her college entrance exam.”

hunks.baseline: “Fair enough. She’s at an important stage.”
hunks.sol: “Fair enough. She’s at an important point.”

hunks.baseline: A brief silence followed. We were comfortable enough not to need conversation, the kind of people who could read each other’s thoughts from a look alone. But right now, neither of us seemed to know what to say.
hunks.sol: A brief silence followed. We were comfortable enough not to need conversation, the kind of people who could read each other’s thoughts with a glance. But right now, neither of us seemed to know what to say.

hunks.baseline: “Hey, hey. Don’t set the mood.”
hunks.sol: “Hey, hey. That’s enough. Don’t make this all sentimental.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s not like you’re an elementary school kid transferring schools. Just because you’re moving, you’re not going to stop seeing me, are you?”
hunks.sol: “You’re not some elementary school kid transferring schools. Just because you’re moving, you’re not going to stop seeing me, are you?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course I’ll see you. I definitely will.”
hunks.sol: “Of course not. I’ll definitely come see you.”

hunks.baseline: “Then it’s fine. Besides, I’m moving my stuff out by the end of today, too.”
hunks.sol: “Then we’re good. Besides, I’m moving my stuff out today too.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m in that area too, you punk!”
hunks.sol: “I’m moving near there too, you punk!”

hunks.baseline: I was secretly pleased by the unexpected news. By now, his was a face I felt lonely not seeing for even a single day. If we lived close by, we could keep meeting often.
hunks.sol: The unexpected news secretly pleased me. By now, I missed his face if I went even a day without seeing it. If we lived close by, we could still meet often.

hunks.baseline: “Hyung, then where exactly is your address—”
hunks.sol: “Hyung, then what’s the exact address—”

hunks.baseline: Just as I was about to ask, the smartphone in my pocket rang. When I answered, a gravelly voice came from the other end.
hunks.sol: Just as I was about to ask, the smartphone in my pocket rang. When I answered, a gravelly voice came through the receiver.

hunks.baseline: It was the private moving-truck driver I had called in advance. I glanced out the window and saw a blue light truck waiting in front of the goshiwon.
hunks.sol: It was the private moving-truck driver I had called ahead of time. I glanced out the window and saw a blue light truck waiting in front of the goshiwon.

hunks.baseline: —Do you have a lot of luggage? If anything’s heavy, I can help you carry it.
hunks.sol: —Do you have a lot of stuff? If anything’s heavy, I can help you carry it.

hunks.baseline: A cardboard box filled with small belongings, and…
hunks.sol: A cardboard box filled with assorted belongings, and…

hunks.baseline: Now that the Logout function had been activated, I no longer needed to use the capsule to travel between the Murim and modern worlds.
hunks.sol: Now that the Logout function had been activated, I no longer needed the capsule to travel between Murim and the modern world.

hunks.baseline: It had become nothing more than a bulky nuisance, but it held a more special meaning for me than anything else. That was the entire reason I had called a moving truck despite having so little luggage.
hunks.sol: It had become nothing more than a bulky nuisance, but it meant more to me than anything else. It was the only reason I had called a moving truck despite having so little luggage.

hunks.baseline: *What would have happened if I hadn’t had this capsule?*
hunks.sol: *What would have happened if it weren’t for this capsule?*

hunks.baseline: I slowly ran my hand over its surface. The coldness of the metal and its rough texture traveled through my fingers.
hunks.sol: I slowly ran my hand over its surface. Cold, rough metal brushed against my palm.

hunks.baseline: *Oh, right. There was also someone who played a major role in that.*
hunks.sol: *Oh, right. Someone else played a big part in that too.*

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t help letting out a quiet laugh at his puzzled expression.
hunks.sol: A laugh escaped me at his puzzled expression.

hunks.baseline: If Jinho hyung hadn’t gotten dead drunk that day, I never would have had a reason to enter the capsule.
hunks.sol: If Jinho hyung hadn’t gotten plastered that day, I never would have entered the capsule in the first place.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. Since you’re here, carry that box down for me. I have to carry the capsule, so I’m short on hands.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. Since you’re here, carry that box down for me. I have to carry the capsule, so I don’t have a free hand.”

hunks.baseline: “What’s with that reaction? Can’t you carry one box for your little brother who’s moving away?”
hunks.sol: “What’s with that reaction? You can’t carry one box for your little brother who’s moving away?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s not it… Ah, now that I think about it, I need to pack my own stuff too. Even if it’s a hassle, just make one trip back and forth. Well, good luck!”
hunks.sol: “That’s not it… Oh, now that I think about it, I need to pack my own stuff too. It might be a hassle, but just make two trips. Good luck!”

hunks.baseline: Look at him slither away like a loach.
hunks.sol: Look at him slithering away like a loach.

hunks.baseline: I watched Jinho hyung’s back as it slowly disappeared into the distance, then eventually picked up the box myself.
hunks.sol: I watched Jinho hyung inch into the distance, then finally picked up the box myself.

hunks.baseline: The moving driver, tired of waiting, honked the truck’s horn. The sound struck my ears.
hunks.sol: The moving driver, tired of waiting, blasted his horn.

hunks.baseline: The moving driver, who had been sneaking glances at me, finally spoke. The light truck, carrying the box and capsule, was heading toward my new home according to the navigation.
hunks.sol: The moving driver, who had been sneaking glances at me, finally spoke. With the box and capsule loaded in the back, the truck followed the navigation toward my new home.

hunks.baseline: “You can tell at a glance. I used to be a Hunter, too. F-rank.”
hunks.sol: “You can tell at a glance. I used to be a Hunter too. F-rank.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m probably your Senior by training-center class. Ah, I’m not trying to pull rank. It would be ridiculous for a guy who quit after exactly one month and handed back his license to act like some old-timer.”
hunks.sol: “I’m probably your Senior by training-center class. Ah, I’m not trying to pull rank. It’d be ridiculous for a guy who quit after exactly one month and handed back his license to act like some old-timer.”

hunks.baseline: The driver continued, sounding as though he were simply airing a long-held grievance.
hunks.sol: The driver continued as though airing a long-held grievance.

hunks.baseline: “Being a Hunter at the training center was manageable. Even though I was only F-rank, I took pride in becoming a Hunter. But the moment I joined a Guild after graduating, an accident happened.”
hunks.sol: “Training at the Hunter Training Center wasn’t so bad. I might have been F-rank, but I was proud to be a Hunter. Then, as soon as I graduated and joined a Guild, there was an accident.”

hunks.baseline: Even if someone lost an arm or a leg, they could recover as long as they had enough money. Hunters didn’t call something that minor an accident.
hunks.sol: Even if someone lost an arm or a leg, they could recover as long as they had enough money. Hunters didn’t call something like that an accident.

hunks.baseline: “He was one of my training-center classmates, and he joined the Guild at the same time as me… Before I knew what was happening, he was dragged away and died just like that. I should have chased after him and saved him, no matter what it took, but I just couldn’t make myself move. After his funeral, I applied for retirement. Someone like me shouldn’t be going on raids.”
hunks.sol: “He was one of my training-center classmates. We joined the Guild together… One second he was there, and the next he was dragged away and killed. I should’ve chased after him and saved him, no matter what it took, but I couldn’t make my feet move. I applied for retirement after his funeral. Someone like me had no business going on raids.”

hunks.baseline: He tried to sound calm, but he couldn’t hide the tremor in his voice.
hunks.sol: He tried to sound calm, but he couldn’t hide the slight tremor in his voice.

hunks.baseline: “I said something awfully ominous in front of a Hunter customer. It’s not exactly a pleasant story. Sorry about that.”
hunks.sol: “Listen to me saying something so ominous in front of a Hunter. It’s not even a pleasant story. Sorry about that.”

hunks.baseline: Being a Hunter was a brutal profession. The media praised them as humanity’s guardians and shields, but they lived with death always at their side.
hunks.sol: Being a Hunter was a brutal profession. The media praised us as humanity’s guardians and shields, but we lived with death constantly at our side.

hunks.baseline: The driver flinched at the navigation’s voice, then muttered,
hunks.sol: The driver paused at the navigation’s voice, then muttered, “Oh, come to think of it, this is a safe zone.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, come to think of it, this is a safe zone.”
The light truck arrived at its destination soon afterward.
hunks.sol: The truck arrived at its destination soon afterward.

hunks.baseline: It was a two-story detached house with a blue roof. A low stone wall surrounded a yard covered in grass. The house felt different from when I had first seen it a few days ago.
hunks.sol: A two-story detached house with a blue roof. A low stone wall and a yard covered in grass. It felt different from when I had first seen it a few days ago.

hunks.baseline: “Wow… It’s a nice house.”
hunks.sol: “Wow… This is a nice house.”

hunks.baseline: The driver climbed out of the cab and clicked his tongue in admiration. Praise sounded sweeter coming from someone else. No matter how hard I tried to suppress it, the corners of my mouth kept rising.
hunks.sol: The driver climbed out of the cab and clicked his tongue in admiration. Praise always sounded sweeter coming from someone else. No matter how hard I tried to suppress it, the corners of my mouth kept rising.

hunks.baseline: “You must be a successful Hunter. My dream was to live in a house like this.”
hunks.sol: “You must be a successful Hunter. Living in a house like this was my dream.”

hunks.baseline: “Your wish came true. You must be happy.”
hunks.sol: “Then your wish came true. You must be happy.”

hunks.baseline: *Of course I was ecstatic.*
hunks.sol: *Of course. I was ecstatic.*

hunks.baseline: The driver continued exclaiming over the place, touching the stone wall and looking over the lawn, before asking,
“Would it be all right if I took a quick look inside? I can help move the capsule while I’m at it.”
hunks.sol: Still marveling at the place, he touched the stone wall and looked over the lawn before asking, “Would it be all right if I took a quick look inside? I can help move the capsule while I’m at it.”

hunks.baseline: The moving driver became the new house’s first guest by accident as he climbed into the truck’s cargo bed.
hunks.sol: The moving driver became the new house’s first guest by accident as he climbed into the truck bed to move the capsule.

hunks.baseline: “It’s fine. I’ve moved plenty of them, so I know. Game capsules are all roughly the same weight.”
hunks.sol: “It’s fine. I’ve moved plenty of them, so I know. Game capsules all weigh about the same.”

hunks.baseline: I knew because I had lifted it myself earlier. It had been moderately heavy even for me, with my Strength stat in the triple digits. For the driver, it would be a different story entirely.
hunks.sol: I knew because I had lifted it myself earlier. It had felt reasonably hefty even to me, with my Strength stat in the triple digits. For the driver, it would be a different story entirely.

hunks.baseline: The driver hugged the capsule and grinned.
hunks.sol: The driver wrapped his arms around the capsule and grinned.

hunks.baseline: “Come on. You’re underestimating me. I may be an ex-Hunter, but something like this shouldn’t—nnngh!”
hunks.sol: “Come on. You’re underestimating me. I used to be a Hunter, you know. Something like this is—nnngh!”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, wow.”
hunks.sol: “Oh.”

hunks.baseline: The only thing that had changed was that the smile had disappeared from his face.
hunks.sol: The only change was that the smile had vanished from his face.

hunks.baseline: “Go ahead and open the doors. Quickly!”
hunks.sol: “Go open the doors. Hurry!”

hunks.baseline: His voice suddenly urgent, I hurried over and threw open the front gate and the house’s entrance door. I had no idea why this had me feeling tense, too.
hunks.sol: At the urgency in his voice, I dashed ahead and threw open the front gate and the front door. I had no idea why I was getting nervous too.

hunks.baseline: He charged into the living room with the urgency of an alarm and shouted like he was screaming for his life.
hunks.sol: He barreled into the living room at an alarming speed and screamed, “Which room?!”

hunks.baseline: “Which room?!”
Fortunately, the door to one of the rooms was already open. With a heavy thud, the driver set down the capsule and began panting.
hunks.sol: Fortunately, one of the bedroom doors was already open. The driver set the capsule down with a thud and began panting.

hunks.baseline: “Why… why is this… huff… so heavy?”
hunks.sol: “Why… is this… huff… so heavy?”

hunks.baseline: It was one of the pieces of furniture the previous owner had transferred to me on the condition that I pay the remaining balance all at once.
hunks.sol: It was one of the pieces of furniture the previous owner had included on the condition that I pay the remaining balance all at once.

hunks.baseline: *I’ll have to live alone for a few months.*
hunks.sol: *I’ll be living alone for the next few months.*

hunks.baseline: Until Hayeon finished her college entrance exam, I planned to eat and sleep here and commute to work.
hunks.sol: Until Hayeon finished her college entrance exam, I planned to eat and sleep here while commuting to work.

hunks.baseline: *I need to remodel the house and buy a car, too. Ah, the Guild said they’d provide the car anyway, so I need to get my license first.*
hunks.sol: *I need to remodel the house and buy a car too. Ah, the Guild said they’d provide me with a car anyway, so I need to get my license first.*

hunks.baseline: There was a mountain of other things to do. But instead of feeling tired, I felt energized. These were all things I hadn’t been able to do before, no matter how much I wanted to.
hunks.sol: There was a mountain of other things to do. But instead of feeling tired, I felt energized. They were all things I hadn’t been able to do before, no matter how much I wanted to.

hunks.baseline: It had only been a few months since I had done nothing but suffer while going back and forth between Gates and the goshiwon, yet so much had changed.
hunks.sol: It had only been a few months since I’d done nothing but struggle back and forth between Gates and the goshiwon, yet so much had changed.

hunks.baseline: A man who had always smiled like a boy despite his age. A man who had done his best for his wife and children and approached them like a friend.
hunks.sol: A man who had always smiled like a boy despite his age. A man who had done his best for his wife and children and treated us like friends.

hunks.baseline: *Dad, I bought a house. The place we used to live in was already gone. But I did well enough, right?*
hunks.sol: *Dad, I bought a house. The place we used to live in is already gone, but… I did pretty well, right?*

hunks.baseline: I wanted to brag about it like a child, but the person who would have praised me had passed away long ago. All I could do was repeat, in my heart, words that could no longer reach him.
hunks.sol: I wanted to brag about it like a child, but the person who would have praised me had passed away long ago. All I could do was repeat words in my heart that would never reach him.

hunks.baseline: When I came to my senses, it was already eight in the evening. The summer sun was slowly sinking.
hunks.sol: When I came to my senses, it was already eight in the evening. The summer sun was slowly setting.

hunks.baseline: An entire week of vacation. It had been hectic because of everything involving the Sangdong Guild, but it was still the best rest I had enjoyed since becoming a Hunter.
hunks.sol: A whole week off. Things had gotten hectic thanks to the Sangdong Guild, but it was still the best rest I’d had since becoming a Hunter.

hunks.baseline: *Precisely twelve hours from now.*
hunks.sol: *In exactly twelve hours.*

hunks.baseline: I lay flat on the sofa where I had been sitting. I briefly considered entering the capsule, but soon dismissed the thought.
hunks.sol: I stretched out on the sofa. The thought of entering the capsule crossed my mind, but I quickly dismissed it.

hunks.baseline: After eleven years, I finally had a home of my own again. Just this once, I wanted to wake up in our living room instead of inside the stuffy capsule.
hunks.sol: After eleven years, I finally had a home again. Just this once, I wanted to wake up in our living room instead of inside that stuffy capsule.

hunks.baseline: A long time after Jin Taekyung lost consciousness, something no one could have expected was taking place in the room beside the front door.
hunks.sol: Long after Jin Taekyung lost consciousness, something no one could have expected was happening in the room beside the front door.

hunks.baseline: The door of the metal object that looked like a gigantic egg—the capsule—slowly began to open.
hunks.sol: The door of the metal object resembling a gigantic egg—the capsule—slowly began to open.

hunks.baseline: The first thing to emerge was a pair of feet.
hunks.sol: The first things to emerge were two feet.

hunks.baseline: Red letters were printed across a pair of long athletic socks that reached up to the calves.
hunks.sol: Red letters were printed across long athletic socks that reached halfway up the calves.

hunks.baseline: Next came sweatpants rolled up halfway to the knees, followed by a pair of pale, skinny hands. The cover of the book he clutched tightly, as though it were scripture, gleamed in the sunset pouring through the window.
hunks.sol: Next came sweatpants rolled halfway up the legs, followed by a pair of pale, skinny hands. The cover of the book he clutched as though it were scripture gleamed in the sunset streaming through the window.

hunks.baseline: After enduring several long hours of agony, he looked as haggard as Crown Prince Sado[^1] yet as relieved as Park Hyeokgeose emerging from an egg.[^2]
hunks.sol: After enduring several long hours of agony, he looked as haggard as Crown Prince Sado[^1], yet as relieved as Park Hyeokgeose emerging from his egg.[^2]

hunks.baseline: A parched voice slipped between his bone-dry lips.
hunks.sol: A dry voice slipped between his parched lips.

hunks.baseline: “Is this my new nest…?”
hunks.sol: “Is this my new home…?”
